facts.value: December 4, 2026 (both domestic and international applicants; Fall 2027 entry only — no spring admission). Letter writers have two weeks past this deadline to submit.

facts.value: GRE scores are NOT required. Submitting them is optional and their absence will not negatively impact the application.

Required for all applicants whose native language is not English (unless degree from U.S. or exempt English-speaking country). Accepted tests: TOEFL iBT, IELTS Academic, PTE Academic. Full enrollment minimums: TOEFL iBT ≥96 total (legacy scoring) or overall band 5 (new scoring); IELTS ≥7.0 overall; PTE ≥68. Scores sent directly from testing agency; self-reported not accepted. TOEFL/GRE institution code: 5814.

notes: FEE DISCREPANCY: The CS dept apply page states '$75' but the Graduate School's own Apply Now page states '$90 non-refundable.' The Graduate School processes the payment, so $90 is the operative amount. Applicants should confirm in the live portal.
DEADLINE IS STRICT: The December 4, 2026 deadline applies to all submitted materials. The only exception is that letter writers get a 2-week grace period after that date.
LETTERS GRACE PERIOD: Recommenders may submit up to ~December 18, 2026 (two weeks after the Dec 4 deadline), but the applicant's own materials must be in by Dec 4.
GRE IS TRULY OPTIONAL: 'If you choose not to submit GRE scores, the absence of these scores will not impact your application' (FAQ page).

TOEFL EXEMPTION: Applicants who hold (or will hold before enrollment) a degree from a U.S. regionally accredited institution or from one of ~40 listed English-speaking countries are exempt from submitting TOEFL/IELTS/PTE.
FALL ONLY: No spring-semester PhD admissions. The portal opens July 1, 2026 for Fall 2027 entry.
FUNDING: All admitted PhD students are guaranteed a TA or RA — stipends $30,800–$33,100 for 9.5 months (AY 2025-26), plus tuition remission and health insurance.
NO WRITING SAMPLE required at any stage per all pages reviewed.
